notes: GLB mesh node names that are real bone nodes in public/models/skeleton.glb but are NOT game answers. Verified against pipeline/node_names.txt: every name here exists in the GLB, and no name here is also mapped by data/bone_catalog.json. The four foot sesamoids are variable in presence and number between individuals (the patella, the other large sesamoid, IS an answer). BodyParts3D 4.0 contains no auditory ossicles and no coccyx, so those are absent rather than ignored. Sternum parts (Manubrium / Body of sternum / Xiphoid process) are NOT ignored: slug 'sternum' maps to all three. The hip bone is a single mesh per side, so slug 'hip-bone' owns it and there are no ilium/ischium/pubis entries.
